learning: Reject bundles that stop at an API or other technical layer instead of delivering an end-to-end improvement.
A complete MiniProject boundary must include the observable outcome, not merely completed backend work.
Return deterministic validation results in plain language unless the user explicitly asks for JSON.
Human-facing validation should say valid or invalid directly and should not expose raw validator plumbing.
Technical-layer ownership repeatedly hides the absence of one end-to-end accountable owner.
When several specialists contribute, one person still needs ownership through verification and release readiness.
Discovery receives a time box and decision outcome rather than an implementation estimate.
Delivery work can be estimated only after unresolved Discovery questions are separated from implementation.
